operation discloses is disclosed here: what a deletion will

The answer arrives on its own. The advisor is slower
than the rest of the product and stays non-blocking while
it thinks. An unreachable service, a timeout, or an
answer nothing usable could be made of is reported as
what it is, and nothing is left looking like a proposal.
Clearing is deliberate. One conversation runs for the
session and nothing clears it on the user's behalf.
The proposal stays outstanding and nothing is written.

A proposal that takes nothing has nothing to disclose.
One that deletes or archives discloses exactly what the
user's own gesture would, because it is that gesture.
